original_value: A fictional 27-inch desktop monitor built for creative studios and reading-heavy workflows, featuring a matte IPS panel, 2560 x 1440 resolution, 75Hz refresh rate, and USB-C input with 65W power delivery. The display emphasizes wide viewing angles, low blue-light modes, and factory-calibrated color tuning for illustration, layout, and office use. It includes a fully adjustable stand, HDMI and DisplayPort connectivity, and an anti-glare coating for long editing sessions.
